Forest-sized blue jellyfish covered with wagon-sized orange, pulsing nodules.

AC 13, HP 63, ATK 4 tendril (double near) +7 (2d8 + create spawn), MV double near (fly, swim), S +6, D +3, C +5, I +3, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 13

Create Spawn. Mortals slain by Oaur-Ooung transform into a qlippoth of equal or lower LV in 1d4 rounds.

Horrific Appearance. Mortal creatures looking directly at Oaur-Ooung, WIS 15+ or dazed for 1d4 rounds. On success, immune for 24 hours.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by cold iron or magical sources. Immune to cold.

Release Swarms. 1/round, when damaged Oaur-Ooung releases 1d4 loyal, chaotic jellyfish swarms.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
